Question: Assala Mualekum,janab hame itna malum karna hai ki ham apni kurbani ki khal ko madarse ko kis condition me de sakte hai.or kis condition me nahi de sakte hai. or hamare yaha par ek kameti hai jo ghareeb logo ke bimari ka ilaj wagehra ke liye free camp lagwati hai.kiya un logo ko ham qurbani ki khaal de sakte hai. Answer ID: 9694 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1687/1390=L/1429) If the madrasa people sell it and spend the amount in due places then it is right to give the skin to the madrasas. Likewise, it can be given to a committee which distributes medicines for free to poor Muslims. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
